$comment: SYNTHETIC catalog assembled from the public_name and metric strings of the PIX 2606.18-preview Intel plugin (PPI-imdp.dll, revamped in 2601.15). Ids, descriptions, data types and groups are invented; replace this file with a real pix_gpu_counters_list dump from an Intel Arc / Xe2 machine (see the contributor checklist in the README).

counters.name: Xe GPU Utilization
counters.description: Overall Xe GPU busy lane (bottleneck style).

counters.name: XVE Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the vector engines were executing instructions.

counters.name: Sampler Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the samplers were busy.

counters.name: Rasterizer Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the rasterizer was busy.

counters.name: Z Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the depth unit was busy.

counters.name: Color Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the color unit was busy.

counters.name: GPU Memory Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of the available memory bandwidth used.

counters.name: Level 3 Cache Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of L3 bandwidth used.

counters.name: Load Store Cache Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of load/store cache bandwidth used.

counters.name: Thread Dispatcher Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the thread dispatcher was busy.

counters.name: Thread Dispatcher Starved
counters.description: Percentage of time the thread dispatcher had no threads to dispatch.

counters.name: Xe Core Thread Dispatcher Starved
counters.description: Percentage of time per Xe core the thread dispatcher was starved.

counters.name: Vertex Fetch Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the vertex fetch unit was busy.

counters.name: Clipper Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the clipper was busy.

counters.name: Render Command Streamer Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the render command streamer was busy.

counters.name: Compute Command Streamer Utilization (%)
counters.description: Percentage of time the compute command streamer was busy.

counters.name: EarlyDepthBottleneck
counters.description: Early depth test bottleneck indicator.

counters.name: XVE_INST_EXECUTED_ALU0_VS_UTILIZATION

counters.name: XVE_INST_EXECUTED_ALU0_PS_UTILIZATION
counters.description: Percentage of time ALU0 executed pixel shader instructions.

counters.name: XVE_INST_EXECUTED_ALU0_CS_UTILIZATION
counters.description: Percentage of time ALU0 executed compute shader instructions.

counters.name: XVE_INST_EXECUTED_ALU1_PS_UTILIZATION
counters.description: Percentage of time ALU1 executed pixel shader instructions.

counters.name: XVE_INST_EXECUTED_ALU2_ALL
counters.description: XMX utilization.

counters.name: XVE_PIPE_ALU0_AND_ALU1_ACTIVE
counters.description: Dual issue of ALU0 and ALU1.

counters.name: XVE_THREADS_OCCUPANCY_ALL
counters.description: Percentage of thread slots occupied.

counters.name: XVE_STALL
counters.description: Percentage of time vector engines were stalled.

counters.name: XVE_STALL_SBID
counters.description: Stalls waiting on scoreboard ids.

counters.name: XVE_STALL_SENDWR
counters.description: Stalls waiting on send writes.

counters.name: XVE_STALL_INSTFETCH
counters.description: Stalls on instruction fetch.

counters.name: XVE_LOAD_STORE_CACHE_READ_MESSAGE_COUNT
counters.description: Number of read messages to the load/store cache.

counters.description: Number of write messages to the load/store cache.

counters.name: XVE_SLM_READ_MESSAGE_COUNT
counters.description: Number of shared local memory read messages.

counters.name: IA Vertices
counters.description: Number of vertices generated by the Input Assembler

counters.name: PS Invocations
